integrity: The universal theorem uses an explicit support-reduction proof and a complete finite closure enumeration, independently checked by direct valuation enumeration through four columns; no certification or extrapolation from experiments is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Full two-row Cartesian S5 grids, one propositional variable, and the single disjunctive knowing-whether bundle only; finite 64-state and 256-mask closure certificate, combined with an induction for all widths. Priority comparison is non-exhaustive and independent audit is not performed.
title: Exact eight-type algebra and sharp three-column cutoff for disjunctive knowing-whether on two-row epistemic grids
